events.what: Casella et al. exhibit an explicit pair of starting hands producing a non-terminating (eventually periodic) game of Beggar-My-Neighbour; found 10 February 2024, written up on arXiv 19 March 2024, published in the American Mathematical Monthly 2025
Andorno, Cernoia, Duiz and Michelangeli's 'Infinite Loop Factory' heuristic search for further non-terminating cycles

judgement.doubts: The deal is also checkable by direct simulation, independently of the Monthly publication. The discovery on 10 February 2024 (Mann's records page) is after the snapshot either way. Direction 'confirmed' is kept because the bullet asks an existence question and the answer is yes; the bullet itself states no conjecture.

corrections.why: F14: the bullet asks whether a non-terminating game exists. The exhibited deal ('---K---Q-KQAJ-----AAJ--J--' / '----------Q----KQ-J-----KA') answers that existence question yes, so it is a witness and contradicts nothing the bullet asserts.
